audit.mapping: source[throttle](durationSelector, { leading: false, trailing: true, restartOnTrailing: false })
audit.note: Adapts audit's duration-next boundary, non-emitting duration completion, source terminal behavior, and cancellation without restarting a duration after a trailing value.

auditTime.mapping: source[throttle](milliseconds, { leading: false, trailing: true, restartOnTrailing: false })
auditTime.note: Numeric duration lifecycle is verified; scheduler arguments are not represented.

buffer.note: Adapts the persistent RxJS 7 closing notifier, completion remainder, error policy, and cancellation lifecycle.

bufferCount.mapping: source[buffer]({ maxSize: bufferSize, startEvery: startBufferEvery ?? bufferSize, emitRemainingOnError: false })
bufferCount.note: Adapts count-sized buffers, including overlapping and gapped startBufferEvery windows, completion partials, and RxJS 7 error behavior.

bufferToggle.note: Supports overlapping buffers, closes on the first closing value but not closing completion, and flushes live buffers in opening order on source completion.

bufferTime.status: Present; scheduler adapted to host timing
bufferTime.note: Preserves tumbling and overlapping host-time windows plus max-size closure. The adapter drops only a recognized trailing SchedulerLike fourth argument.

bufferWhen.mapping: source[buffer]({ delay: closingSelector, emitEmpty: true, emitRemainingOnError: false })
bufferWhen.note: Uses the unified buffer delay selector and discards the active partial buffer when the source errors.

catchError.note: Replaces source errors with any ObservableValue, preserves caught-source retry identity, and trampolines synchronous retries.

combineLatest.note: Adapts variadic sources to the current array form; projection overloads remain unrepresented.

combineLatestAll.note: Collects inner sources until outer completion, then delegates combination to the exact static combineLatest Symbol and projection to map.

combineLatestWith.note: Maps the With variant to the unified combineLatest Symbol.

connect.note: Creates one connector per active result run, establishes the selector result before source activation, and owns selector/source cancellation through the result signal.

concat.note: Adapts variadic sources to the current array form.

concatAll.note: Flattening is expressed through mergeMap with concurrency one.

concatWith.note: Maps the With variant to the unified concat Symbol.

count.note: Counts all values or predicate matches and emits the total only after successful completion.

debounceTime.note: Numeric delays reset a host timer, flush on completion, and cancel via AbortSignal. Scheduler arguments are not represented.

delay.status: Present; scheduler adapted to host timing
delay.note: Uses host time virtualized by @rxjs/test. The compatibility adapter drops only a recognized legacy SchedulerLike second argument and rejects other extra values.

delayWhen.note: Releases each value on its duration's first next, swallows it on empty duration completion, and supports the deprecated subscription-delay gate.

dematerialize.note: Converts next, error, and completion notification shapes back into their represented Observable signals.

defaultIfEmpty.note: Exact type and lifecycle parity remain test-driven.

distinct.note: Uses Set equality, optional key selection, and an optional flush source that clears remembered keys.

distinctUntilChanged.note: Uses strict equality by default and compares selected keys against the last emitted key.

distinctUntilKeyChanged.note: Delegates property-key comparison to the exact distinctUntilChanged Symbol contract.

elementAt.note: The default-value overload is present; the no-default out-of-range error remains compatibility evidence.

every.note: Evaluates value, index, and source and cancels upstream before emitting the first false result.

endWith.note: Adapts trailing values to one iterable concat source; a trailing SchedulerLike is retained as an explicit unsupported-overload failure.

exhaust.note: Legacy flattening alias maps to exhaustMap.

exhaustMap.note: Legacy result-selector overloads are not represented.

expand.note: Adapts legacy numeric concurrency to the options contract. Scheduler arguments are not a public platform contract; their ported behavioral claims use explicit test-harness timing rewrites.

finalize.note: Runs once after completion, error, or last-observer cancellation without replacing the platform finally method.

filter.note: The RxJS Symbol form preserves predicate index, type guards, errors, and cancellation without replacing the platform string method; callback receivers must use closures or Function.prototype.bind.

find.note: Emits the first matching value or undefined with predicate index, source identity, and early cancellation, without replacing the platform find() Promise consumer; callback receivers must use closures or Function.prototype.bind.

findIndex.note: Emits the first matching index or -1 with predicate source identity, errors, and early cancellation; callback receivers must use closures or Function.prototype.bind.

flatMap.note: RxJS 7 flatMap is an alias of mergeMap.

first.note: Preserves predicate, default-value arity, EmptyError, early cancellation, and the distinct RxJS Symbol contract without replacing the platform first() Promise consumer.

groupBy.note: Emits hot read-only keyed group views with options and deprecated positional selector forms; active group observers may retain source work after outer cancellation.

ignoreElements.note: Maps each input to an ambient empty Observable while retaining source completion and error behavior.

isEmpty.note: Emits false and cancels upstream on the first value, or emits true after successful empty completion.

last.note: Preserves predicate, default-value arity, EmptyError, completion-time selection, and the distinct RxJS Symbol contract without replacing the platform last() Promise consumer.

map.note: The RxJS Symbol form preserves projection index, errors, and cancellation without replacing the platform string method; callback receivers must use closures or Function.prototype.bind.

mapTo.note: Expresses constant projection through mergeMap and an ambient single-value Observable.

materialize.note: Converts every source signal into a Notification next value and completes after materialized error or completion.

max.note: Delegates unseeded maximum selection and lifecycle behavior to the exact reduce Symbol.

merge.note: Adapts variadic sources and the numeric concurrency overload.

mergeMap.note: Adapts numeric concurrency; result-selector overloads remain unrepresented.

mergeScan.note: Updates shared accumulator state from concurrent inner emissions, queues source values at the concurrency limit, and drains before completion.

mergeWith.note: Maps the With variant to the unified merge Symbol.

min.note: Delegates unseeded minimum selection and lifecycle behavior to the exact reduce Symbol.

multicast.note: Returns a manually connected compatibility Observable without a selector, or delegates selector forms to the exact Symbol-keyed connect contract.

observeOn.note: The exact Symbol uses virtualizable host timers and AbortSignal cancellation. Ported RxJS 7 evidence adapts only its rxTest TestScheduler argument; other SchedulerLike implementations remain unsupported.

onErrorResumeNext.note: Adapts variadic or single-array source arguments to the current array form.

pairwise.note: Emits consecutive value tuples from the second value onward with shared activation state and cancellation.

pluck.note: Traverses one or more string, number, or Symbol keys through the exact map Symbol and returns undefined after a nullish path segment.

publish.note: Returns a manually connected retained-Subject result without a selector, or a fresh selector-scoped Subject for each active platform run.

publishBehavior.note: Returns a manually connected result backed by one retained BehaviorSubject with the requested initial value.

publishLast.note: Returns a manually connected result backed by one retained AsyncSubject that emits only the final value after completion.

publishReplay.note: Uses a retained replay connector for manual results and a fresh connector for selector runs. Defined scheduler arguments are not a public platform contract; their ported timing claims use explicit test-harness rewrites.

race.note: Adapts variadic or single-array sources to the current array form.

raceWith.note: Maps the With variant to the unified race Symbol.

reduce.note: Distinguishes omitted and explicitly undefined seeds and emits accumulated state only on successful completion.

refCount.note: Connects a concrete ConnectableObservable on its first active platform producer run and disconnects after the final run ends.

repeat.note: Adapts the legacy numeric count to a config object.

repeatWhen.note: Creates one hot completion stream and one notifier per shared activation; repeats are sequential and notifier completion or error controls the shared result.

retry.note: Adapts legacy numeric and config inputs while preserving the RxJS 7 resetOnSuccess default.

retryWhen.note: Creates one hot error stream and one notifier per shared activation; retries are sequential and notifier completion or error controls the shared result.

sample.note: Samples the latest unseen source value on notifier emissions; notifier completion does not complete or flush the result.

sampleTime.status: Present; scheduler adapted to host timing
sampleTime.note: Uses a host interval virtualized by @rxjs/test; the generator marks the legacy TestScheduler argument for this adapter and other scheduler arguments remain unsupported.

scan.note: Exact overload and no-seed behavior remain test-driven.

sequenceEqual.note: Supports strict equality by default and the RxJS 7 comparator overload.

share.note: Shares one connector and source connection per active run with configurable reset behavior. A late observer joining an already-active platform result bypasses operator initialization, so a replaying custom connector cannot replay history to that observer; ColdObservable compatibility fanout retains that behavior.

shareReplay.note: Uses share with a size/host-time-bounded replay connector, persistent successful terminal cache, error reset, and optional ref-count reset. Active platform late observers cannot receive connector history; ColdObservable and post-terminal activations can. Defined scheduler arguments are not a public platform contract; their ported timing claims use explicit test-harness rewrites.

single.note: Requires exactly one value or predicate match and preserves RxJS 7 EmptyError, NotFoundError, and SequenceError outcomes.

skip.note: Suppresses the first count values while preserving completion, errors, and cancellation.

skipUntil.note: Subscribes to the notifier first, opens after its first value, ignores notifier-only completion, and cancels both inputs through the shared result lifecycle.

startWith.note: Synchronously emits configured prefix values before source activation. Legacy trailing scheduler overloads are not a public platform contract; their ported behavioral claims use explicit test-harness timing rewrites.

subscribeOn.note: The exact Symbol delays source activation with a virtualizable host timer and AbortSignal cancellation. Ported RxJS 7 evidence adapts only its rxTest TestScheduler argument; other SchedulerLike implementations remain unsupported.

switchMap.note: Legacy result-selector overloads are not represented.

switchMapTo.note: Legacy result-selector overloads are not represented.

switchScan.note: Carries inner emissions as accumulator state, cancels the prior inner on each source value, and waits for the current inner after source completion.

tap.note: Preserves notification side-effect ordering plus subscribe, unsubscribe, and finalize lifecycle hooks.

take.note: Completes after the requested count and cancels upstream through the derived subscriber signal; nonpositive counts do not activate the source.

takeUntil.note: Subscribes to the notifier first, completes on its first value, ignores notifier-only completion, and cancels both inputs through the shared result lifecycle.

takeWhile.note: Normalizes the RxJS 7 inclusive boolean to the RxJS Next configuration form.

throwIfEmpty.note: Forwards nonempty sources and errors an empty completion with a fresh EmptyError or the configured factory result.

timeInterval.status: Present; scheduler adapted to host timing
timeInterval.note: Uses a now-only provider. The port harness maps the legacy TestScheduler argument to @rxjs/test's virtual host clock and rejects other scheduler arguments.

timeout.note: Adapts legacy numeric and Date due arguments; scheduler arguments are not represented.

timeoutWith.note: Maps fallback behavior to the unified timeout configuration; scheduler arguments are not represented.

timestamp.status: Present; scheduler adapted to host timing
timestamp.note: Uses a now-only provider. The port harness maps the legacy TestScheduler argument to @rxjs/test's virtual host clock and rejects other scheduler arguments.

toArray.note: Uses one unbounded buffer and emits it only on successful completion.

window.note: Emits read-only hot windows, activates source before boundaries, rotates on boundary values, and silently releases the live window on outer cancellation.

windowCount.note: Emits read-only count windows with tumbling, overlapping, or gapped cadence. Source completion completes live windows, source errors error them, and outer cancellation silently releases them.

windowTime.status: Present; scheduler adapted to host timing
windowTime.note: Preserves tumbling and overlapping host-time windows plus max-size closure. The adapter removes recognized legacy SchedulerLike objects from optional argument positions without changing numeric arguments.

windowToggle.note: Emits overlapping read-only windows, closes each window on the first closing value, and silently releases live windows on outer cancellation. This cancellation behavior intentionally does not reproduce RxJS 7's disposed-Subject ObjectUnsubscribedError.

windowWhen.note: Emits consecutive read-only windows and rotates on the first closing value or completion. Synchronous closing rotation is iterative, and outer cancellation silently releases the live window.

withLatestFrom.note: Adapts variadic other sources to the current array form and preserves the optional projection overload.

zipAll.note: Collects inner sources until outer completion, then delegates tuple formation to hardened zip and projection to the exact map Symbol.

zip.note: Normalizes the deprecated RxJS 7 zip operator to the exact zipWith Symbol and applies its optional result selector through the exact map Symbol.

zipWith.note: Delegates receiver-first variadic tuple formation to the hardened standalone zip contract.

animationFrames.note: Legacy scheduler arguments are not represented.

combineLatest.note: Adapts variadic sources to an array; projection overloads remain unrepresented.

concat.note: Adapts variadic sources to the current array form; scheduler arguments are not represented.

defer.note: Uses the ambient Observable constructor and defers the factory until subscription.

empty.note: Uses the current EMPTY singleton; the deprecated scheduler overload is not represented.

from.note: Scheduler arguments and the complete RxJS 7 input matrix remain test-driven.

fromEvent.note: Maps EventTarget inputs to the platform when() surface, normalizing boolean capture options; once, unsupported option keys, non-EventTarget inputs, and third- or fourth-argument result-selector overloads fail explicitly.

forkJoin.note: Supports array, object, deprecated rest, empty-input, and result-selector forms while preserving last-value and early-empty cancellation behavior.

generate.note: Supports synchronous positional and options-object generation. Scheduler fields and trailing scheduler arguments are not a public platform contract; their ported behavioral claims use explicit test-harness timing rewrites.

iif.note: Expressed as an ambient Observable with subscription-time source selection.

merge.note: Adapts variadic sources and the numeric concurrency overload.

onErrorResumeNext.note: Adapts variadic or single-array source arguments to the current array form.

of.note: Adapts variadic values to the platform Observable.from contract.

partition.note: Returns matching and rejected branches with independent predicate state over the platform source's shared, ref-counted activation.

race.note: Adapts variadic or single-array sources to the current array form.

range.mapping: Observable.from(Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => start + i))

throwError.note: Supports factory and legacy direct-error forms; scheduler arguments are not represented.

timer.note: Adapts an absolute Date to a relative delay; scheduler arguments are not represented.

ArgumentOutOfRangeError.note: Uses the public RxJS 7-compatible missing-index error value.

AsyncSubject.note: Provides the RxJS 7 final-value Subject contract with current, late, error, cancellation, and reentrant observer behavior.

BehaviorSubject.note: Adapts the current factory to the RxJS 7 constructor call shape; lifecycle parity is unverified.

ColdObservable.note: Producer-per-subscription compatibility test surface; not a platform Observable parity claim.

connectable.note: Creates a manually connected Observable with a stable AbortController-backed connection facade and configurable connector reset.

ConnectableObservable.note: Provides the concrete manually connected compatibility class used by standalone connectable and legacy multicasting operators.

config.note: Captures the RxJS 7 onUnhandledError test hook and routes platform reportError calls through it for the lifetime of one rxTest run.

EMPTY.note: Uses the current standalone empty Observable singleton.

EmptyError.note: Uses the public RxJS 7-compatible empty-sequence error value.

firstValueFrom.note: Maps Promise conversion to the platform consumer; the RxJS 7 defaultValue configuration is not represented.

fromEventPattern.note: Registers one stable handler per active platform run and removes it with the exact registration token on final cancellation.

identity.note: Uses the public generic identity utility.

lastValueFrom.note: Maps Promise conversion to the platform consumer; the RxJS 7 defaultValue configuration is not represented.

Observable.note: Uses the active native or fallback platform constructor.

NEVER.note: Uses the current standalone never Observable singleton.

NotFoundError.note: Uses the public RxJS 7-compatible missing-match error value.

Notification.note: Provides the deprecated RxJS 7 Notification class, its shared completion instance, dispatch helpers, and Observable conversion.

ObservableNotification.note: The runtime sentinel exists only so mechanically migrated tests can retain the erased RxJS 7 notification union import.

Observer.note: The runtime sentinel exists only so mechanically migrated tests can retain the erased platform Observer import.

Operator.note: The runtime sentinel retains the erased custom-Observable operator annotation in migrated lift evidence.

noop.note: Uses the public no-operation callback utility.

ReplaySubject.mapping: new ReplaySubject(bufferSize, windowTime) → replaySubject({ size: bufferSize, maxAge: windowTime })
ReplaySubject.note: Adapts bufferSize and windowTime to the current factory. The exact port harness accepts only its rxTest virtual-clock marker as the third argument, relying on virtualized host Date.now/setTimeout; every other timestamp-provider or scheduler fails explicitly.

SequenceError.note: Uses the public RxJS 7-compatible invalid-sequence error value.

Subject.note: Uses the current exploratory Subject class. Subject.asObservable() returns a distinct non-mutating Observable view without patching the platform Observable prototype.

Subscription.note: The runtime sentinel retains erased annotations for the connection returned by connect(); migrated cases invoke unsubscribe() on the actual connection value.

TimeInterval.note: Provides the legacy value class used by exact timeInterval expectations without reviving scheduler internals.

TimeoutError.note: Uses the public RxJS 7-compatible timeout error value and metadata shape.

pipe.note: Adapts RxJS 7 standalone operator composition to the current static pipe Symbol.

zip.note: Adapts variadic and single-array source forms plus the trailing RxJS 7 result selector to the current source-array function.
